title: Rename apply in-flight progress
summary: Shows rename.apply in-flight progress immediately after confirmation while the backend command is still pending, then replaces it with the backend-authored result.
reason: The progress bar was rendered only from the final rename.apply success payload, so operators saw no progress evidence until the synchronous backend apply request had already completed.
behavior_before: The Rename Apply progress area stayed empty while /api/rename/apply was running and only displayed the completed green bar after the backend response returned.
behavior_after: The Rename Apply progress area shows an active in-flight bar and Applying status as soon as the confirmed backend request is submitted; final counts remain backend-authored.
